concept.text: Bottom-up: Delphi literature claims and equations. Top-down: design requirements. The gaps appear where they do not meet.

execution_note: Packages with no unresolved predecessor can run concurrently under the declared dependencies. Disjoint input lists do not prove the packages are independent, and resource conflicts (people, equipment, compute) are not modelled. Nothing here is executed or decentralized: all rows are proposals.

next_experiment.not_claimed: No expected-information-gain or utility number ranks the packages: the assurance map leaves both null because cost and outcome models are absent.
why_this_one: It is the only item that both removes an explicit essential blocker (tissue-to-EI) and has a stated measurement in the owning handoff.
The ensemble fractions differ across candidates only under assumed envelopes; the fin assay's own next step is EI(x), and mesh refinement alone does not address the larger uncertainties.
Planner structure result: deflection-only reads leave stiffness and load scale confounded (rank 1), so the measurement must include an independent load read.

non_claims: No new simulation, measurement or inference was run to make this map.
Fractions are conditional simulation-envelope fractions, not probabilities of biology.
Local elasticities hold other inputs fixed and are not causal biological effects.
provenance_notes: Data S1A pelvic/SL column holds a corrupt value (2.4e-16, specimen 1); the owner recomputed it from lengths and kept both.
Neighbouring groups fit differently (flying-fish pelvic, halfbeak pelvic) and are outside this map; do not generalise the flying-halfbeak pelvic non-detection.
separation: Humans set the target goals. Solver or model validity (checked equations, convergence, controls) is a different thing from empirical biological realism, which is unknown for every layer here.
